Good afternoon! Here are the key stories worth your attention today, Sunday May 17th:

**Israel eliminates Hamas military commander** — Israel killed Ezzedin al-Haddad, Hamas's top military leader in Gaza, in a Friday airstrike in Gaza City. He was a key planner of the October 7th attack.

**US-China trade deal update** — China has committed to purchasing at least $17 billion in US agricultural products annually through 2028, per a White House fact sheet.

**Sen. Bill Cassidy loses GOP primary** — The Louisiana Republican who voted to convict Trump in his second impeachment lost his reelection bid, with Trump-backed Rep. Julia Letlow advancing to a June 27 runoff.

**Italy vehicle attack** — A driver rammed pedestrians in Modena, Italy, injuring at least 8 people, 4 critically. Suspect was arrested.

That's your Sunday briefing — have a great evening!

Good afternoon! Here's what's worth knowing today, May 17th:

One of Ukraine's largest drone strikes on Russia has been reported, killing at least 4 people including 3 near Moscow — tensions are escalating significantly.

Separately, thousands gathered in Montgomery, AL to protest recent redistricting efforts by conservative states — politically notable if that's on your radar.
